purpose: Measure how many chronological calibration scenes are required to install or select a compact safe task-action codebook for a previously unseen activity.

decision_rules.few_shot_adaptation_viable: For at least three N values, K <= 4 and calibration budget <= 8 achieve macro future coverage >= 0.90, worst-activity future coverage >= 0.80, zero unsafe coded actions, and positive full-session payload savings.
decision_rules.bank_reuse_viable: The preinstalled bank selector meets the few-shot adaptation gate without installing new action tuples.
decision_rules.ai_ranker_entry: Calibration adaptation is viable, but the bank selector is not; train a regret-aware candidate ranker to reduce calibration or installation cost.
decision_rules.reject_direct_global_vq: The zero-shot global codebook remains below 0.80 worst-activity future coverage at K = 8.

claim_boundary: All 2024-2025 scenes were already consumed and are development-only.
The chronological suffix is an internal future segment, not a new Final holdout.
Oracle future fitting is an unattainable upper bound and cannot be reported as an implementable method.
Every compact action is accepted only after exact regret verification; otherwise the system escapes to the exact action.
